best_documented_result: Largest 52-week between-group FVC difference in a phase 3 IPF trial: 130.1 mL (95% CI 82.2-178.1), inhaled treprostinil vs placebo, median change -43.3 vs -196.2 mL
what_remains_unachieved: Every active arm of every positive trial still declines. Across positive phase 3 arms the active-arm change ranges from -43.3 to -138.6 mL/52 wk.
caveat: Metrics are not interchangeable: TETON reports median change, INPULSIS annual rate, FIBRONEER absolute change; placebo-arm decline ranges from -136.4 to -239.9 mL, so mL differences cannot be ranked across trials (L3).

best_documented_result: 47.9% relative reduction in the proportion of patients with >=10 point FVC%pred decline or death at 52 weeks (pirfenidone vs placebo)
what_remains_unachieved: No trial has shown that progression can be prevented outright; the residual progression rate in treated arms remains substantial.
caveat: Categorical and continuous FVC endpoints are not interchangeable (E3).

best_documented_result: Least-declining active arm reported: -21.5 mL over 26 weeks (deupirfenidone 825 mg, frequentist adjusted mean change)
what_remains_unachieved: No completed IPF RCT arm has reported a sustained positive change in FVC. Recovery of lost function has never been demonstrated in humans.
caveat: A near-zero slope over 26 weeks is not recovery and is not durable evidence; the trial's own verdict class is Uncertain.

best_documented_result: None. No human trial endpoint measures reversal (E15).
what_remains_unachieved: Everything. There is no validated measure, no trial precedent and no regulatory pathway.
caveat: Preclinical reversal reports do not license any human claim (L2).

best_documented_result: Pooled RR 0.63 (95% CI 0.53-0.76, I2=0%) for acute exacerbation with antifibrotic therapy
what_remains_unachieved: No adequately powered randomised demonstration of acute-exacerbation reduction; TETON-1/-2 exacerbation endpoints were hierarchy-stopped, i.e. not formally tested (L3).
caveat: Incidence and prognosis both shifted with the 2016 definition change (E10), so pooled historical estimates mix definitions.

best_documented_result: Highest documented placebo-adjusted reduction in objective cough frequency: 60.2% relative reduction (31.5 to 11.9 coughs/h; P<.001) with nalbuphine ER 108 mg vs 16.9% with placebo at week 6; earlier crossover trial reported a 50.8 percentage-point placebo-adjusted change at day 21. Low-dose morphine gave 39.4% (95% CI -54.4 to -19.4; p=0.0005) at day 14.
evidence_tier: RCT (phase 2b dose-ranging, 6 weeks) + RCT (crossover) + RCT (small crossover)
what_remains_unachieved: Durability beyond 6 weeks, independent (non-sponsor) replication, the phase 3 result, and any effect on disease course. Opioid-class tolerability is the trade-off: nausea, fatigue, constipation and dizziness exceeded placebo in the crossover trial.
caveat: Symptom domain only; licenses no statement about fibrosis, lung function or progression (E9). Updated in C11.

dimension: Symptoms - dyspnoea / health-related quality of life
best_documented_result: No intervention has shown an HRQoL or dyspnoea difference exceeding the relevant MCID in a pivotal IPF trial in retrieved evidence. INSTAGE (nintedanib+sildenafil) SGRQ difference -1.28 vs -0.36, null.
what_remains_unachieved: Any demonstrated improvement in how patients feel, as opposed to how fast a surrogate declines.
caveat: MCID thresholds themselves are contested (E6, E7).

best_documented_result: No positive pivotal result. STEP-IPF primary endpoint (>=20% 6MWD improvement) 10% vs 7%, not significant.
what_remains_unachieved: A demonstrated improvement in exercise capacity from any disease-directed drug.
caveat: Pulmonary rehabilitation evidence is separate and is not disease-directed therapy.

best_documented_result: No randomised evidence of a survival benefit for any drug. Best available: pooled RR 0.55 (95% CI 0.45-0.66, I2=82%) for all-cause mortality with antifibrotics; registry HR 0.56 (95% CI 0.34-0.92); causal-inference HR 0.53 (95% CI 0.28-1.03, p=0.060).
evidence_tier: Meta-analysis of mostly observational data; registry; causal-inference cohort
what_remains_unachieved: A randomised mortality demonstration. Trial-level surrogacy of FVC for mortality was not established in any source retrieved by this Phase 1 search.
caveat: All-cause-mortality trials in mild-to-moderate IPF were judged of prohibitive size, duration and cost (PMID 24476390), which is why this gap persists; the only RCT with mortality as primary endpoint was negative (INSPIRE HR 1.15, 95% CI 0.77-1.71).

best_documented_result: Randomised comparison is limited to ~52 weeks for every currently approved or recently positive agent.
what_remains_unachieved: Randomised evidence beyond one year; whether the slope difference is maintained, widens or attenuates.
caveat: Open-label extension and real-world cohorts are not randomised comparisons.

best_documented_result: Lung transplantation: 5-year survival 55.2% in the most recent era analysed, up from 51.9% (p=0.02); adjusted HR 0.83 (95% CI 0.76-0.91) for the later era
what_remains_unachieved: Transplantation is limited by candidacy, organ supply and age; it replaces the lung rather than treating the disease. Bilateral vs single choice trades short-term for long-term risk (PMID 19949142).
caveat: No randomised comparison of transplantation against medical therapy exists or is feasible.

best_documented_result: None reported in any retrieved human evidence.
